description:
We are looking for a Conversation AI Specialist who builds agentic, process-aligned dialogue systems — not scripted chatbots. You will build the conversational intelligence layer of our advisor efficiency platform. It includes timely orchestration, intent reasoning, and LLM-powered assist systems that help advisors during complex customer interactions across chat, phone, and ecommerce. You will own the full conversation stack, from utterance to action.
Key Responsibilities
Agentic Conversation Design: Architect and build the conversational layer of our prompt-based agentic platform — including intent detection, dialogue orchestration, and multi-step reasoning flows aligned to advisor workflows.
LLM Integration & Prompt Engineering: Design and maintain the prompt architecture that drives advisor-assist features — including context injection, tool-calling patterns, guardrails, and output validation.
Advisor Assist Systems: Build real-time AI tools that surface relevant knowledge, suggest responses, and guide advisors through commerce, subscription, and support interactions.
Process Mapping: Work with operations and product teams to deeply understand advisor business processes, then translate that understanding into conversation system design.
Evaluation & Quality: Define conversation quality metrics, build evaluation datasets from real interaction logs, and operate a continuous improvement loop for deployed systems.
Probabilistic Fallback Design: Design graceful degradation patterns — ensuring the system handles low-confidence states, ambiguous intents, and out-of-scope inputs without advisor disruption.
Cross-platform Delivery: Integrate conversational AI features throughout chat, phone, and ecommerce advisor surfaces — maintaining coherent behavior across channels.
Attitude & Approach We're Hiring For
Beyond technical skills, we are specifically hiring for three attitude shifts that define success in this role:
Process-aligned composition: you build conversation flows that mirror advisor operational workflows — not abstract dialogue trees disconnected from how work actually happens.
Probabilistic reasoning: you architect systems where intent is inferred, confidence is tracked, and ambiguity is handled gracefully rather than failing hard.
Data-driven iteration: you measure conversation quality with data, not intuition — defining metrics, curating evaluation sets, and iterating based on evidence.
Required Qualifications
3–5 years in conversational AI, NLP engineering, or LLM-based product development.
Experience building dialogue systems with real business process alignment, not just scripted flows.
Proficiency in Python and NLP tooling
Strong understanding of intent classification, entity extraction, and context management in stateful conversations.
Experience deploying conversational AI to production with real user traffic.
Ability to build for uncertainty — confidence scoring, fallback handling, human-in-the-loop blocking issue.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience building agentic systems with tool use, function calling, or multi-step LLM orchestration. Familiarity with RAG for knowledge-grounded responses.

description:
About DevRev
At DevRev, we're building the future of work with Computer – your AI teammate. Unlike traditional tools, Computer unifies all your data sources, tools, and workflows into a single AI-ready platform, giving employees real-time insights, proactive suggestions, and powerful agentic actions. It extends your existing software with AI-native apps and agents that work alongside your teams and customers – updating workflows, coordinating across teams, and eliminating repetitive work. We call this Team Intelligence: human-AI collaboration that breaks down silos, brings people back together, and frees you to solve bigger problems. Backed by Khosla Ventures and Mayfield with $150M+ raised, DevRev is trusted by global companies across industries.
About the role
As a Forward Deployed Engineer for Implementation Partners at DevRev, you will be the technical bridge between DevRev, our implementation partners, and their customers. You will combine strong software engineering, systems integration, applied AI, and customer-facing problem solving to help partners successfully design, build, deploy, and scale solutions on the DevRev platform.
This is not a traditional software engineering role. You will operate at the intersection of engineering, solution architecture, partner enablement, product expertise, and delivery . You will work directly with partners and customers to understand requirements, scope solutions, unblock implementations, and translate complex business workflows into AI agents, integrations, automations, and repeatable vertical solutions.
You will own the technical partner journey end to end — from onboarding, enablement, and certification through solutioning, implementation delivery, technical adoption, and ongoing partner success. At the same time, you will build reusable internal tools, frameworks, playbooks, and product capabilities that allow DevRev and its partners to scale across multiple implementations.
Success in this role requires strong technical depth, ownership, and presence. You should be comfortable writing production-quality code, designing integrations and data flows, working with APIs and cloud infrastructure, using SQL and observability tools to troubleshoot complex systems, and applying modern AI techniques such as LLMs, RAG, function calling, prompting, and evals.
You will also be an AI-augmented builder , using tools such as Claude Code, Gemini, and DevRev Computer to accelerate development, investigation, documentation, and delivery while applying sound engineering judgment.
Ultimately, your role is to make our implementation partners dramatically more effective — helping them deliver faster, solve harder problems, scale across customers, and represent DevRev with technical credibility and confidence.
What you'll do
Client-facing: 50% working directly with external customers and partners.
Internal Building & Product SME: 50% building for internal customers (internal stakeholders) and acting as the go-to product expert.
Own the End-to-End Implementation Partner Lifecycle: Take ownership across the full implementation-partner lifecycle — partner onboarding, enablement and certification, co-selling and deal support, implementation delivery, and ongoing partner management — covering all partner-related work across every engagement.
Build & Run Partner Enablement: Create partner enablement courses and hands-on training materials, track partner progress and engagement through dashboards, and act on those insights to close gaps and drive certification and readiness.
Build & Deploy Solutions: Design, develop, and launch AI agents, skills, integrations, and automations that connect DevRev with customers' existing tech stacks and workflows.
Build Vertical Solutions: Design and develop industry-specific, vertical solutions (e.g. pharma, financial services, retail) — packaging DevRev's platform into repeatable, domain-tailored offerings that map to real customer use cases.
Co-Build Vertical Solutions with Partner PMs & Product Leaders: Work with implementation partners' Product Managers and Product leaders to shape, scope, and co-build vertical solutions — aligning on use cases and priorities and jointly deciding what gets built.
Scale Horizontally Across Partner Implementations: Support multiple partner implementations in parallel — reusing frameworks, playbooks, and solutions to drive delivery across many engagements at once rather than one at a time.
Be the Face of DevRev: Represent DevRev as the technical face in partner calls — and sometimes directly in customer calls — building trust, guiding decisions, and owning the technical relationship.
Unblock Everything: Solve both technical and non-technical blockers across partner implementations, keeping delivery moving and stepping in wherever a project is stuck.
Integrate Systems: Connect DevRev with SaaS and non-SaaS platforms through APIs, webhooks, and real-time communication architectures for seamless one-way and two-way data flow.
Build for Internal Stakeholders: Design and ship internal tools, agents, and automations that make DevRev's own field, delivery, and go-to-market teams faster and more effective.
Product SME: Serve as the subject-matter expert on the DevRev platform — the go-to person internal teams and partners rely on for deep product, integration, and agent guidance.
Close the Product Feedback Loop: Turn field learnings into structured product input — filing issues and enhancements, and partnering with Product and Engineering to shape the roadmap and unblock delivery.
Optimize AI Performance: Apply prompt engineering, fine-tune semantic search engines, and leverage generative AI techniques to enhance agent accuracy and user experience.
Scope & Estimate: Run requirements gap analysis, solution design, and effort estimation so partner and delivery teams start with a clear, grounded plan.
Own Data Insights: Write SQL queries, perform data analysis, and build dashboards to surface insights that drive customer and delivery decision-making.
Prototype & Iterate: Develop rapid proofs-of-concept, conduct live technical demos, and refine solutions based on customer and stakeholder feedback.
Manage Stakeholders & Cross-functional Alignment: Manage expectations across partner, customer, and internal stakeholders, and keep tight communication loops with engineering, product, customer success, support, and revenue teams to ensure alignment.
Guide Technical Adoption: Learn and master new tools, then guide partners through critical workflows like code repository integrations and advanced configurations.
What you'll bring
Experience: 5+ years in software development, systems integration, or platform engineering. Customer-facing experience is a plus.
Background: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
Coding Skills: Strong proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, data structures and algorithms. (Nice to have: Go)
Applied AI Knowledge: Familiarity with large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, frameworks like RAG and function calling, and building evals to validate agentic AI solutions.
Integration Expertise: Deep experience with large-scale data synchronization (one-way and two-way), API integration patterns (REST, GraphQL, webhooks), and event-driven/pub/sub architectures.
Cloud & Deployment: Hands-on experience deploying on serverless and edge platforms (AWS Lambda, Google Cloud Functions) with modern DevOps practices (CI/CD, containers, observability).
Data Transformation: Skilled in data mapping, schema alignment, and working with heterogeneous systems. Understanding of data modeling and graph data structures.
Observability: Experience implementing clear logging, actionable error surfacing, and telemetry to support faster debugging and issue resolution.
Context-Aware Systems: Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) for building adaptive, context-aware integrations.
End-to-End Partner Ownership: Ability to own the implementation-partner lifecycle end to end — from onboarding and enablement through co-selling, delivery, and ongoing partner management.
Partner Enablement: Ability to build enablement courses and hands-on training, and use dashboards to track progress and drive partner readiness.
Vertical & Domain Awareness: Ability to learn a customer's industry quickly and translate domain requirements into product and solution design.
Stakeholder Management & Communication: Skilled at managing expectations and building trust across partner, customer, and internal stakeholders, and articulating technical concepts clearly to engineers, product teams, and business stakeholders.
Ownership & Presence: Able to be the trusted technical face in partner and customer calls and scale across multiple engagements at once.
Problem-Solving: Strong track record triaging and unblocking both technical and non-technical blockers to keep projects moving forward.
Documentation: Experience writing concise, well-structured documentation that supports long-term team understanding and seamless onboarding.
How do we work?
Whatever your role, our values describe what we ask of each other.
Be a bridger
Look beyond your own role. Ask questions, share context and help others get unstuck. That may mean bringing the right people together or picking up a problem that doesn’t necessarily fit neatly into your job description.
Care loudly
We want your perspective, not just your agreement. Speak up when something isn’t working or someone needs support. Give honest feedback with respect for the person receiving it. Don’t let an uncomfortable conversation become an unspoken problem.
Own the outcome
Take responsibility for the result, not just your part in the process. Use AI to move the work forward, not to outsource your judgment. Make the call, check whether it worked and change course when it didn’t. If something goes wrong, own it and help fix it.
That’s DevRev!

The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.
What is The Role
The Elastic IT team is moving beyond simple chat to the next frontier: Agentic Workflows and Agent-to-Agent (A2A) Systems. We are looking for an innovative Agentic AI Engineer to join our team. You will build multi-agent ecosystems that are self-directed. These ecosystems will do more than just answer questions. They will collaborate, delegate tasks, and execute complex business processes across the organization.
In this role, you will focus on large language models (LLMs), agent orchestration, and A2A integration frameworks to power our intelligent workforce. You will create workflows for multiple agents instead of just focusing on single-agent search or managing the stack. These workflows will enable the agents to communicate with each other, share information, access enterprise tools, and automate tasks from start to finish. Driven by a service-oriented mindset, you will empower internal teams with cutting-edge LLM capabilities while integrating seamlessly with enterprise systems.
Are you ready to build the next generation of LLM-powered multi-agent systems that supercharge enterprise productivity? Join us to enable agent-to-agent workflows that turn collective knowledge into instant, coordinated action across Elastic.
What You Will Be Doing
A2A Architecture & Multi-Agent Orchestration: Design, build, and deploy agent-to-agent (A2A) communication architectures and workflows that enable autonomous agents to collaborate, delegate tasks, and negotiate multi-step business processes.
LLM Integration & Tool Calling: Integrate advanced LLMs, both proprietary and open-source, with enterprise APIs. Use tool-calling methods. Connect with third-party SaaS applications for smooth operations.
Enterprise Grounding & RAG: Use advanced Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) techniques. Implement strategies that connect enterprise context by using search and vector storage engines. This will ensure that all inter-agent operations are highly accurate and reliable.
Scalable Infrastructure & IaC: Provision and manage robust cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) using Terraform to support the high-concurrency demands of LLM inferences and multi-agent coordination.
DevOps & Lifecycle Management: Support modern DevOps practices. This includes creating CI/CD pipelines for automated testing, deployment, and versioning. You will also evaluate LLMs and agentic workflows regularly.
A2A Security & Governance: Apply strict security and network fundamentals (VPC configurations, secure API gateways, encryption, and IAM controls) to secure inter-agent communication and protect sensitive enterprise data.
LLM Observability & Evaluation: Create systems to monitor how multiple agents interact. These systems will help us check model accuracy. They will also help manage token spending and identify model drift or agent loops.
Documentation: Keep detailed technical documents for LLM integration protocols. This includes A2A interaction flows and cloud infrastructure deployments.

Experience with AI-assisted development, code review, test generation, working through unfamiliar code, drafting specifications, summarizing incidents, and accelerating research.

WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion is looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer focused on migrations to join our growing team in India. You will help deliver complex, production-grade data migrations, integrations, and automations for customers across APAC.

This is initially an internally focused, hands-on engineering role. You will partner closely with regional Forward Deployed Engineers, who own customer discovery, solution architecture, stakeholder communication, risk management, and final customer validation. You will own the behind-the-scenes technical execution layer from feasibility assessment and implementation through testing, production rollout, QA, reconciliation, reporting, and operational handoff.

You will work across multiple customer environments and source systems, often with incomplete requirements, imperfect data, and real-world constraints. Success requires strong engineering fundamentals, sound judgment, careful validation, and the ability to turn one-off delivery work into reusable tools and repeatable playbooks.

As a founding engineer in India, you will help build a new regional engineering capability from the ground up. You will create migration infrastructure, standards, and reusable tooling used by FDEs across APAC, while establishing practices that can scale globally. The role offers an opportunity to become a technical authority for production migration delivery, shaping how Notion approaches reliability, validation, and operational quality across complex customer environments. As the team grows, the role may also expand toward customer-facing FDE work, technical leadership, or a deeper engineering path, depending on business needs and demonstrated capability.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Own the technical execution layer after customer requirements, scope, and solution architecture have been established with the regional FDE. Contribute to feasibility assessment, estimation, implementation planning, and risk identification while the regional FDE remains accountable for customer discovery, scope, architecture, stakeholder communication, and final acceptance.

 - Apply a repeatable migration lifecycle covering source inventory and sampling, scope and pruning decisions, compatibility and degradation assessment, transformation design, pilot or dry run, user acceptance testing, production cutover, reconciliation, remediation, hypercare, and documented handoff.

 - Translate approved customer and regional FDE requirements into clear technical designs, implementation plans, test strategies, runbooks, and delivery estimates.

 - Build production-quality migration utilities, backend services, data pipelines, integrations, and automations using Python, SQL, APIs, databases, and cloud infrastructure.

 - Investigate source-system behavior, data quality issues, permissions, rate limits, authentication constraints, and edge cases, then recommend practical solutions.

 - Design and validate permissions, ownership, and inheritance mappings against the approved migration plan. Make unsupported or ambiguous access requirements explicit, obtain the required decision or approval, and preserve evidence of validation.

 - Design migrations for reliability, scale, security, observability, idempotency, failure recovery, and safe reruns.

 - Execute migrations only through approved environments, devices, accounts, and tooling. Follow least-privilege access, customer-specific security and data-residency requirements, and approved handling procedures. Do not store customer data in unmanaged local or external systems, and escalate privacy, security, or sovereignty concerns before execution.

 - Build validation and reconciliation frameworks that provide clear evidence of migration completeness, accuracy, and exceptions.

 - Debug failures across application code, infrastructure, customer data, third-party systems, and the Notion platform, then drive issues through resolution.

 - Manage multiple implementation workstreams, dependencies, and priorities while communicating scope, progress, risks, and trade-offs clearly.

 - Surface scope changes, unsupported requirements, timeline risks, and material effort increases early. Document assumptions and trade-offs, and escalate with options and a recommended path rather than silently absorbing additional work.

 - Maintain an auditable record of scope, decisions, risks, approvals, validation evidence, and customer acceptance criteria in the agreed shared workspace or channel.

 - Convert repeated delivery patterns into reusable components, automation, documentation, and playbooks that improve speed, quality, and cost over time.

 - Bring field learnings back to Notion's Product and Engineering teams as actionable platform feedback and technical requirements.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 3 to 6 years of hands-on experience in backend engineering, data engineering, integration engineering, implementation engineering, technical consulting, solutions engineering, or a similar technical role.

 - Strong hands-on Python development experience.

 - Working experience with Node.js, JavaScript, or TypeScript.

 - Strong SQL skills and a solid understanding of relational databases, data modeling, and data transformation.

 - Experience working with REST APIs, JSON, authentication, webhooks, and system integrations.

 - Experience owning a production migration, integration, or technical implementation through mapping, transformation, testing, rollout, validation, and handoff.

 - Experience taking a technical problem from requirements and design through development, testing, deployment, and production operation.

 - Experience with Git, code review, automated testing, release practices, and production deployment.

 - Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills across code, data, infrastructure, and external systems.

 - Evidence of working on production systems, not only prototypes or proof-of-concept projects.

 - Clear written and verbal English communication, with the ability to explain technical decisions, constraints, and risks to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

 - High agency and ownership. You are comfortable making progress with incomplete information, challenging assumptions, and escalating with options and a recommendation.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, job orchestration, or infrastructure automation.

 - Experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure.

 - Familiarity with message queues, event-driven systems, distributed-system patterns, retries, concurrency, and rate limits.

 - Experience with monitoring, logging, alerting, or other observability tools.

 - Experience with enterprise SaaS applications, professional services, or large-scale customer implementations.

 - Experience migrating large volumes of content or structured data between enterprise platforms.

 - Experience with AI or LLM applications, retrieval-augmented generation, evaluation frameworks, or agentic workflows.

 - Familiarity with MCP, tool calling, Notion Workers, Custom Agents, or similar extensibility platforms.

 - Experience working with distributed global or APAC teams.




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE:

In your first 90 days, you will:

 - Learn Notion's migration and implementation ecosystem, engineering standards, and APAC delivery model.

 - Establish a productive working rhythm with regional FDE partners.

 - Contribute to at least one migration or integration workstream through production delivery.

 - Leave behind clear technical documentation, validation evidence, and an operational runbook.

Within your first six months, you will:

 - Independently own production migration or integration workstreams from technical design through rollout and handoff.

 - Deliver measurable improvements in migration turnaround time, validation quality, delivery cost, or regional FDE execution hours through reusable engineering.

 - Help establish repeatable quality controls, code review practices, runbooks, and observability patterns for the India team.

 - Demonstrate effective prioritization and communication across multiple concurrent APAC engagements.

 - Turn at least one repeated delivery pattern into a reusable tool, component, or playbook that is adopted by a subsequent engagement.




LOCATION:

Forward-Deployed Engineer, Agent Studio
About Agent Studio
Agent Studio helps Razorpay merchants run AI agents across payments, checkout, disputes, subscriptions, reconciliation, risk, and customer workflows. We take the messy, undocumented work merchants do every day and turn it into reliable production agents.
The role
We're hiring a Forward-Deployed Engineer who is equal parts engineer, solution consultant, and merchant partner — the single technical owner of the merchant relationship. You'll sit directly with strategic merchants, run the discovery, find the real constraint behind the ask, design the solution, build the first working version, prove whether it moved the metric, and expand from there.
This is a deeply customer-facing role. You'll own the conversation — not hand it off. You'll walk into a room where the business owner, the ops lead, and the dashboard all tell different stories, and you'll be the one who reconciles them into a spec everyone agrees to ship. Then you'll go build it. You earn the customer's trust because you can do both — reshape the ask and write the code.
If you like being close to the problem, comfortable in front of customers, and can ship, this is for you.
What you'll own
Customer discovery & the relationship
Own merchant conversations end-to-end — discovery calls, workshops, solution reviews, and rollout check-ins. You're the merchant's trusted technical advisor.
Sit inside merchant workflows long enough to understand the real process, not the documented one. Ask who actually does the work and what happens when it fails.
Reconcile conflicting signals across business owners, operators, dashboards, CRM, and ticket queues into a clear problem statement.
Solution design & consulting
Name the business constraint behind the ask: checkout recovery, dispute win rate, RTO loss, SIP recovery, settlement delay, refund spikes, support load, or cashflow leakage.
Convert fuzzy merchant problems into crisp agent specs: success metric, data sources, tool calls, guardrails, human-in-the-loop points, and rollout plan.
Decide what the agent does on its own, what it recommends, and where a human must approve.
Write the spec clearly enough that product, engineering, legal, and the merchant all agree on what ships.
Hands-on build & integration
Build prototypes, connectors, MCP tool specs, eval fixtures, dashboards, and the glue code that gets an agent into production.
Debug integration failures across Razorpay systems, merchant systems, external tools, and model behavior.
Deploy across the constraints that real merchants have — auth, networking, data access, latency, cost per run, observability, and compliance — and keep them in the design from day one.
Proof, expansion & productization
Set quality gates and outcome metrics before rollout. Track production outcomes, not demo applause.
Measure whether the agent moved the target metric. If it didn't, diagnose and fix — or kill it with evidence.
Drive expansion through building: spot the next high-value use case, prototype it, and deepen the merchant's agent footprint over time.
Turn repeated field patterns into reusable Agent Studio capabilities — connectors, templates, eval packs, docs, platform requirements. You are the field voice that shapes what the platform builds next.
You may be a fit if you
Have 3+ years shipping production software, and are strong in Python or TypeScript.
Have worked directly with customers, enterprise stakeholders, or operators — and are comfortable owning the room and the technical relationship.
Have hands-on experience with APIs, webhooks, auth, data pipelines, and production debugging.
Have practical LLM/agent experience: prompts, tool calling, RAG, evals, or workflow automation.
Prefer ambiguous, high-context problems over clean tickets.
Take ambiguous problems, define the structure, and drive them to resolution
Write clearly — specs, implementation plans, and crisp follow-ups.
Strong pluses
Prior shape: solutions engineer, solution consultant, sales engineer, founding engineer, product engineer, applied AI engineer, or an operator who wrote code.
Payments, fintech, ecommerce, subscriptions, risk, reconciliation, settlement, or finance-ops experience.
Worked with MCP servers, agent skills, multi-agent workflows, eval harnesses, or LLM observability.
Enterprise integration experience: private connectors, VPC/on-prem constraints, SOC2/ISO reviews.
What this role is not
Not a pre-sales demo role where success is a slick walkthrough.
Not a pure implementation role where success is shipping whatever the merchant asked for.
Not a support role where success is closing tickets.
Not a research role where success is a clever agent that never reaches production.
